sections.h2: 1. Compare the code with Vivid Days (until November 30)
parts: Evilhair's home page calls Vivid Days its take on Black Friday: 15% off 1 to 2 products, 30% off 3 to 4 products and 45% off 5 or more full-size products, taken off in the cart with no code, until Cyber Monday, November 30. That beats the {pct} code. Fill your cart first, then try {code}: if the total doesn't drop further, the shop takes one discount or the other, so keep the bigger one.

Each ColorConditioner comes in 100 ml for €15.99 or 200 ml for €23.99, so the big bottle costs about 25% less per ml (€0.12 against €0.16). Evilhair says the Intense colors last up to 12 washes and the Pastel colors up to 7, and suggests using it once a week to keep the color, so a regular user gets through a bottle quickly.

Bundles pair two 200 ml bottles or a color with its matching shampoo. The Intense Violet Purple and Intense Magenta Pink bundle costs €44.60, €3.38 less than the two bottles at €23.99 each. With the code it comes to €40.14. Evilhair also offers a discount coupon for your next order when you leave a product review, according to its home page.

Evilhair says it processes orders in 1 to 2 business days, then shipping takes 3 to 10 days, and up to 15 working days for most international parcels. All parcels can be tracked, though outside the EU only through your local post office. Shipping is free on orders over €115, its home page says. Holiday delivery can take 1 to 3 working days longer.

Returns are accepted within 25 days of delivery, for unused products in their original packaging bought on evilhair.com, with proof of purchase. Opened or used products can't be returned. Email its support within those 25 days to start a return; approved refunds go back to your original payment method within 8 days, Evilhair says. Read our [Evilhair review](saving-tips-evilhair-review.html) first: many Trustpilot reviewers say their orders were slow to arrive or never arrived.
